applies_why: The judge resolves the Isaiah 7:14 link by treating the sign's own silence as decisive, rather than weighing the pressing side's chain against the other chain by footing.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse - I weighed (1) requiring comparison of the whole chains by footing versus (2) allowing a verse-alone test of whether the sign states the mechanism.
why: Because the judge uses the sign's own failure to state the mechanism as the reason for UNDERDETERMINED, it applies the retired verse-alone stating test instead of comparing the chains by footing.
